messages:
omar: Quick heads-upwe're launching a small dedicated capacity wave in NA-WEST with a new inference SKU: rtx600 (32GB, low-latency optimized). Go-live target: Wed Aug 14 05:00 UTC.
jisoo: Pools created will be `rtx600-na-west` and `rtx600-na-west-burst`. Initial rollout: 3 AZs, staggered to limit impact.
vanessa: Sequence: na-west-1a -> 1c -> 1b, ~12 nodes per zone, 6 node burst buffer. Partner preview booked for Aug 13 20:00-22:00 UTC in 1a.
sre-lead: Ops note: rolling infra updates only; tenant workloads should remain online. We'll enable increased trace sampling for the first 36h to catch regressions.
ops-bot: SCHEDULED: rtx600 capacity wave starting 2061326400. Zone windows: 2061326400-2061412799.
finance-bot: Billing: rtx600-dedicated will use an intro preview rate. We'll publish final pricing after a 1-week bake; early adopters get prorated credits if prices drop.
vanessa: Important policy: minimum reservation term for preview customers is 1 week to allow rapid feedback. Normal terms apply post-preview.
jisoo: Routing: new allocations will prefer rtx600 when eligible. Hard-pinned reservations will not be auto-migrated. We'll offer a one-click migration in Console for qualifying customers.
omar: Support playbook: tag infra tickets `rtx600-rollout`. Escalation: @support -> @sre-lead -> @vanessa. Canned reply drafted for customer queries about perf vs existing SKUs.
support-bot: TEMPLATE: "Were deploying rtx600 in NA-WEST. Reply with your project id to request early access or migration assistance."
vanessa: Telemetry to monitor: token-level P50/P95, kernel OOM events, KV-cache hit rate, and GPU mem fragmentation. We'll enable a short-lived debug sampler for 15% of traffic.
jisoo: Reminder to Eng teams: this capacity is inference-only; training jobs will be blocked by quota during rollout windows.
omar: Partner preview success criteria: stable P95 within 10% of baseline, no increase in OOMs, and at least one customer migration completed.
vanessa: I'll post a follow-up perf summary after the preview and publish internal migration snippets. Ping me for whitelist requests.
jisoo: thanks all :thumbsup:
